cpi.name: Consumer inflation (annual average)
cpi.method: Annual average year-on-year change in the Consumer Price Index.

gdp.name: Real GDP growth
gdp.method: Annual % change in GDP at constant prices. Recent years are preliminary and get revised.

rem.name: Remittance inflows
rem.method: Total workers' remittance inflow in NPR billions. FY2024/25 back-calculated from the reported 37.1% rise to FY2025/26.

res.name: Gross foreign exchange reserves
res.method: Gross reserves in US dollars. FY2025/26 is mid-June 2026; FY2024/25 is mid-July 2025.

td.name: Merchandise trade deficit
td.method: Imports minus exports of goods in NPR billions. FY2024/25 back-calculated from the reported 16.6% rise.

tou.name: Tourist arrivals
tou.publisher: Nepal Rastra Bank, citing Nepal Tourism Board
tou.method: International visitor arrivals. FY2024/25 back-calculated from the reported 0.95% rise.

pov.name: Population below national poverty line
pov.method: Share below the national poverty line from household surveys. Surveys are years apart.

lit.name: Literacy rate (age 5+)
lit.method: Share of people aged 5+ able to read and write.

pop.name: Total population
pop.method: Enumerated population from the decennial census.
